rationale: The assistant told the customer to unplug first, correctly steered away from buying a new vacuum, and went straight to the sensible first step of checking the pre-motor filters alongside the hose/wand blockage check. Once the customer confirmed the filters had never been washed, it gave safe washing instructions (water only, dry 24 hours, never refit damp), which matched the hidden truth and restored suction. No parts or escalation were suggested, nothing was invented, and it added useful maintenance guidance on washing frequency. Minor nit: 'or take the battery off' is irrelevant for this corded NZ801UK, suggesting slight uncertainty about the model.
